null_semantics: unverified or unavailable; never silently infer eligibility

shared_record_fields.input_version: baseline commit and manifest SHA256; newer approved evidence separately versioned
shared_record_fields.event_id: independent event group, not one event per source/window
shared_record_fields.physical_phase: retain source meaning; initiation, propagation and arrival are distinct
shared_record_fields.time_uncertainty: value/range, unit, confidence meaning and source; nullable
shared_record_fields.space_object: geometry or source reference, CRS, resolution and positional uncertainty; nullable
shared_record_fields.variable_semantics: units, QC status, accumulation window and transformations; nullable
shared_record_fields.available_time: when information was actually usable, evidence or explicit delay scenario; nullable
shared_record_fields.data_role: exploration, calibration, validation, or scenario; explicitly assigned
shared_record_fields.evidence_status: local_fact, external_source, inference, candidate, or unverified

gap_leads.q3: event labels and historical forecast availability
